headline: Share, export and keep more of your work
intro: This week brings quick ways to show off your character, more control over how you export, and a calmer way to get new characters and their moves started.

highlights.title: Share a character preview quickly
highlights.text: You can now share a quick preview of your character, with simpler share controls that pack all facings. Scaled share exports and a PNG copy that sticks around are also new.

highlights.title: Export settings you control
highlights.text: Export settings are now saved across sessions, and each animation can have its own explicit export settings. A native GDevelop project export and a grouped export picker are also new.

highlights.title: New characters start with Default
highlights.text: Creating a character now gives you a standing Default move first. You can then add idle and walk moves with Add idle + walk, and queued moves run one at a time.

highlights.title: Cleaner bodies and better-fitting items
highlights.text: New base bodies are now drawn bare, so torso items no longer show a gray shirt through them. Items can also hide the body pixels they cover, like ears under a hood.

fixes.text: Unsaved outfit edits now survive a quick reload or tab close.
Phaser and Unity exports now keep your animation timing.
